changeSet.comment: Refactor job_roles, job_type, and contract_type from users table to separate tables
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO user_job_roles (user_id, job_role) SELECT id, TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(job_roles, ',', numbers.n), ',', -1)) as job_role FROM users CROSS JOIN ( SELECT 1 n UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9 UNION SELECT 10 ) numbers WHERE job_roles IS NOT NULL AND job_roles != '' AND CHAR_LENGTH(job_roles) - CHAR_LENGTH(REPLACE(job_roles, ',', '')) >= numbers.n - 1 AND TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(job_roles, ',', numbers.n), ',', -1)) != '' AND CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(job_roles, ',', numbers.n), ',', -1))) <= 35;

INSERT INTO user_job_roles (user_id, job_role) SELECT id, TRIM(job_roles) FROM users WHERE job_roles IS NOT NULL AND job_roles != '' AND job_roles NOT LIKE '%,%' AND CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(job_roles)) <= 35;
INSERT INTO user_job_types (user_id, job_type) SELECT id, job_type FROM users WHERE job_type IS NOT NULL AND job_type != '' AND job_type IN ('REMOTE', 'HYBRID', 'ONSITE');

INSERT INTO user_contract_types (user_id, contract_type) SELECT id, contract_type FROM users WHERE contract_type IS NOT NULL AND contract_type != '' AND contract_type IN ('EMPLOYMENT', 'B2B', 'EOR', 'INTERNSHIP');
